text:
Communication
Technical Procedure
Introduction
The SX-50 
 communication system is an integrated communication system able to send and 
 receive both voice and data signals it is a compact wall-mounted system. Using 
 stored program control and advanced digital techniques its modular design 
 allows easy fault finding and circuit card replacing with out disturbing the 
 system.
The first draft is 
initiated and tested by eng. AbdEl Aleem Ahmed, accepted by eng. Sleem Ahmed 
Ali general director, approved by 
eng. Abd El Kerim Abu Zeid Ismail Head Sector of High Dam Hydraulic Power 
Station, and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem: HPGC technical inspection 
general director & MPIS Coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, qualified maintenance 
 staff carry the suitable safety ID category,

 by dry cleaning spray.
